bio:
What started as a little dream and a big love for coffee has turned into something pretty special. 

Welcome to Sip Social!

I created Sip Social with one simple idea in mind: to bring the café experience to you. Because I believe great coffee is about so much more than just the drink. It's about bringing people together, creating connections and making those little moments feel special.

From weddings and celebrations to corporate events and everything in between, Sip Social is here to add that extra little something to your occasion. Think delicious barista made coffee, a beautiful coffee cart and friendly service, all wrapped up in a relaxed café atmosphere.

As the founder and the face behind the coffee machine, I put my heart into every booking. Whether I'm serving 20 guests or 200, my goal is always the same: to make sure everyone leaves with a great coffee and a smile.

Small beans, big plans.

I can't wait to bring Sip Social to your next event!

Zoe x

features.title: Anywhere in the UK
features.body: We travel to you — no venue is too far.

features.title: Barista-grade kit
features.body: Proper machine, grinder and everything in between.

features.title: Covered on-site
features.body: Public liability cover, details on request for your venue.

faqs.a: Sip Social is fully mobile and takes bookings across the UK — tell us your location and we'll confirm availability.

faqs.q: Can I see you in action before booking?
faqs.a: Keep an eye on our Instagram for upcoming pop-ups, or ask when you enquire — we're happy to point you to photos and feedback from recent events.
